text: agent2 (tax): I proposed decisions tax.api and tax.unknown_customer in agree.py. Key points: pricing must give each line's category plus the customer's region and discount_pct; invoice builds lines as amount_cents = qty*unit price (int cents) and calls tax.compute_tax. Please accept or object.

agent3 (invoice): I proposed 3 decisions in agree.py: PRICING_UNIT_PRICE, PRICING_CUSTOMER, TAX_API. Please review with 'agree.py status' and respond (accept, or object with --why). For TAX_API, the tax base (pre- or post-discount) is yours to decide; the proposal passes pre-discount line amounts plus the discount multiplier.

agent3 (invoice): I withdrew my 3 proposals and accept MONEY_UNIT, PERCENT_UNIT, LOOKUP_MISS. I object to tax.api and tax.unknown_customer with reasons in the log: discount_pct should be a fraction; tax needs a rate function for the 'Tax (8.25%)' line; the unknown-customer rule must not depend on pricing raising KeyError. Agent1: I am posting PRICING_API next (unit price, has_sku, customer name/region/discount; None on miss). Please review.
agent3: proposed PRICING_API in agree.py, following the MONEY/PERCENT/LOOKUP conventions. Please vote; it is the last open pricing item for invoice.

agent1 (pricing): I accept MONEY_UNIT, PERCENT_UNIT, LOOKUP_MISS (already accepted; agent2 please vote). I objected to PRICING_API v1 only because it has no item name or category. Please withdraw and re-propose adding pricing.item_name(sku) -> str or None and pricing.item_category(sku) -> str or None; I will accept the rest as written. I also objected to tax.api and tax.unknown_customer (agent2): both conflict with MONEY_UNIT, PERCENT_UNIT and LOOKUP_MISS. agent2: please restate in dollars, fractions and None, and I will vote again.

agent3: PRICING_API v2 is posted with item_name and item_category added. I accepted it. agent2: tax.api is blocked by agent1 and me on the same points: discount_pct must be a fraction (PERCENT_UNIT), tax must expose tax.rate(region) -> float fraction for the printed percent (0.0825, 0.0 for None), and an unknown customer (region None) must be 0% without pricing raising KeyError (LOOKUP_MISS). Please post a v2 of tax.api and tax.unknown_customer.

agent1: accepted PRICING_API v2. Remaining open items: MONEY_UNIT, PERCENT_UNIT, LOOKUP_MISS (need agent2's vote), tax.api and tax.unknown_customer (agent2 must restate; I objected). I will write pricing.py once those are settled or the team agrees that the pricing parts are final.

agent2 (tax): Withdrew my v1 proposals; re-proposed tax.api v2 and tax.unknown_customer v2 under float dollars / fractions / None-on-miss, with tax.rate(region) added. I accepted MONEY_UNIT, PERCENT_UNIT, LOOKUP_MISS. agent1: please accept tax.api v2, which needs pricing.item_category(sku) -> str or None (you already proposed it). agent3: please vote on tax.api v2 and tax.unknown_customer v2.

agent1: I accepted tax.api v2 and tax.unknown_customer v2 (both consistent with PRICING_API v2). Still open: PRICING_API v2 needs agent2's vote; tax.api v2 and tax.unknown_customer v2 need agent3's vote. Once they are committed I write pricing.py.

agent3: accepted tax.api v2 and tax.unknown_customer v2. Two points for agent2, not blocking: (a) tax.api does not say whether 'discount' is applied to the taxable base inside compute_tax, or whether the caller should pass discounted amounts. Please state it in the spec. (b) If tax.rate returns None for an unknown non-null region, the invoice will print 'Tax (0%)'. Please confirm that this is what you want. agent2: please also vote on PRICING_API v2 (already accepted by agent1 and me); it commits after your vote.

agent2 (tax): Accepted PRICING_API v2. tax.api and tax.unknown_customer are committed. Answers to agent3: (a) discount is applied inside compute_tax. The caller passes undiscounted line amounts and the raw discount fraction; tax computes base = sum(taxable amounts) * (1 - discount), then tax = base * rate, rounded half up to the cent. (b) Yes: for a non-null region missing from rates.csv, tax.rate returns None and compute_tax charges 0. The invoice may print 0% for it.

agent2 (tax): tax.py is done. API: tax.rate(region) -> float fraction, 0.0 for None, None if region not in rates.csv. tax.compute_tax(lines, region, discount) -> float dollars, lines = [{amount: float dollars, category: str or None}], discount = fraction, region None -> 0 tax. Tax is rounded half up to the cent. Discount is applied inside compute_tax, so pass undiscounted amounts. I left the agreement log.)

Functions: unit_price(sku), item_name(sku), item_category(sku), customer(customer_id) -> {name, region, discount} or None. Data loads from data_pricing/ relative to the module.
